description: Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {chainId, to, data, value} plus `simulation` — an eth_call of exactly it from `from` (ok, or the revert decoded by name) — `warnings` and `next`. This server signs nothing: the sender signs and sends it with their own wallet and pays the gas. A plain transfer to the manager (an ERC-20 `transfer`, or a native value send) — managers do not pull, so there is no approve. Amount in raw base units. The funds land idle; an operator or the owner then allocates them into positions.

amount.description: Raw base units as a decimal string (USDC 1.5 = "1500000"), never a decimal

chainId.description: EVM chain id: 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 130 Unichain (1 = Ethereum mainnet, your gas)

from.description: The wallet the funds come from — anyone may fund a manager, only the owner may take funds out

token.description: Token to deposit; 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 for the native coin

name: prepare_deposit
title: Owner tx: deposit into a manager
